name: CapCut - Video Editor
summary: CapCut is a free video editor for Android from Bytedance, the company behind TikTok, with templates, auto captions, effects and a multitrack timeline. The latest CapCut APK is version 19.9.0, updated October 30, 2026, and needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free with no ads, and CapCut Pro unlocks extra features.
metaDescription: Get the official CapCut APK 19.9.0 for Android 6.0+. Free video editing with templates and auto captions: what's in Pro, install steps and safety notes.

faq.q: How do I install CapCut on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for CapCut and check the developer is Bytedance Pte. Ltd. before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically, so you never need to download an APK by hand. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Bytedance Pte. Ltd. and may be altered, so the safest way to use CapCut is the official listing.

Yes. CapCut is free to download, has no ads, and most editing tools are free. CapCut Pro is an optional subscription that unlocks premium effects, templates, AI tools and more cloud storage. Google Play lists in-app purchases from $0.49 to $900.00, covering Pro plans and other paid items.

The official CapCut app from Google Play is a legitimate app from Bytedance, the company that owns TikTok. Read its terms before editing client or sensitive footage: they give CapCut broad rights over content you upload to its services. Never install modified "Pro" versions, which can steal your account.

CapCut can add an ending clip with its logo to exported videos, and you can delete it from the timeline before exporting. Some templates and Pro features may add a watermark if you use them without a subscription. Check the export preview before you post.

faq.q: Why is CapCut not available in my country?
faq.a: CapCut isn't available everywhere. India, for example, has banned CapCut along with other ByteDance apps since 2020. If Google Play says the app isn't available in your country, that's a regional restriction, and installing an APK from another site doesn't change it.
